newsitem.title: USA: Fed could refrain from open market intervention.
newsitem.headline: Fed could refrain from open market intervention.

text.p: The Federal Reserve could refrain from open market operations on Friday, analysts said.

"With the coupon pass settling and other (repurchase agreements) in place, we suspect the desk can stay out," said analysts at MMS International, though they said that there is "a large add need left" in the current two-week reserve maintenance period.
Fed funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, the Fed's target for the rate, at mid-morning.
